name: Gabor Fields
definition: A Gabor Field is a single continuous decomposition consisting of a low-pass, high-density volume of Gaussians (zero-ω Gabors) plus a residual of Gabor kernels carrying higher frequencies.
summary: Gabor Fields are a volumetric representation using Gaussian bases and Gabor residuals to enable orientation-selective level-of-detail and faster rendering than standard Gaussian methods.
